title: EXISTING FINGER BONES — DIAGNOSIS, SEMANTIC MAP, AND APPEND-ONLY HAND MOTIONS (P1)
specNature: PROPOSAL ONLY. No runtime, CLI, output, or sample asset is authorized by this document.

supersedes.disposition: SUPERSEDED_FOR_NEW_WORK; retained as immutable audit trail

purpose: For private rigged and skinned GLBs that already contain usable finger bones, diagnose only, map those existing bones to separate NURION semantic IDs, and eventually append a minimal hand-motion library without changing source bytes or sealed BODY, FACE, and TALKING evidence.
outOfScope: weight synthesis, painting, repair, or normalization
Meshy, user, result GLB, IRG ZIP, or private authority-bundle publication
reopening NURION_ADAPTATION_ENGINE_V2, RIG-02, V05, V06, or V07
CLI flags or runtime implementation before authority is granted

forbiddenActions: rename, reparent, add, remove, or rest-pose-edit upstream nodes or bones
publish private samples or visual receipts

semanticIdentityContract.principle: Semantic IDs are mapping metadata, never requested upstream bone names.
semanticIdentityContract.canonicalExistingBodyNodeRule: When these existing node names occur, preserve their bytes, names, hierarchy, transforms, skin membership, and inverse-bind-matrix relationship exactly; map them to semantic IDs without renaming.

P01CalibrationLock.purpose: Lock flexion, abduction/adduction, thumb opposition, rotation-axis convention, rest-pose comparison method, weight acceptance method, and all tolerances from a private calibration set before any approval transition.
P01CalibrationLock.acceptanceMethod: Conservative, evidence-backed acceptance. The lock must define a lower confidence bound and a second-best mapping margin, plus tolerance derivation from the private calibration distribution; no universal confidence, weight, angle, penetration, or epsilon number is invented in R2.
P01CalibrationLock.publicPolicy: Publish schema and digests only; retain samples, screenshots, raw measurements, and asset identifiers privately.

authorityTransitionRule: Only after a valid P01 calibration-lock receipt may the states APPROVED, then OPEN_PROTOTYPE, then GRANTED occur in that exact order. A missing, mismatched, or private-evidence-incomplete receipt leaves authority NONE.

requiredEvidence: per-side finger-chain presence and parent hierarchy
skin joint membership and inverse-bind-matrix evidence

blockedReasons.NO_FINGER_BONES_HAND_UNIT_GESTURE_ONLY: No resolvable articulated finger-bone chains exist. P1 must not create bones or synthesize weights; require HAND-02 consideration and Blender manual guidance.
blockedReasons.MISSING_WRIST_OR_HAND_CHAIN: No unambiguous wrist-to-hand parent chain exists.
blockedReasons.INCOMPLETE_FINGER_CHAIN: One or more required digit chains are absent, discontinuous, duplicated, or have unresolved parentage.
blockedReasons.AMBIGUOUS_FINGER_MAPPING: The P01 lower-confidence-bound or second-best-margin rule does not accept exactly one mapping.
blockedReasons.LATERALITY_CONFLICT: Left/right evidence, hierarchy, or geometric side evidence conflicts.
blockedReasons.REST_POSE_OR_AXIS_UNRESOLVED: Rest pose or the calibrated rotation axis cannot be established conservatively.
blockedReasons.HAND_SKIN_OR_IBM_UNRESOLVED: Hand joints are not verifiably present in the bound skin or their inverse-bind-matrix evidence is unavailable or inconsistent.
blockedReasons.HAND_WEIGHT_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Existing weights cannot be accepted by the P01 method. This is not authorization to repair them.
blockedReasons.FUSED_OR_NON_SEPARABLE_FINGER_GEOMETRY: Mesh evidence cannot support the required visual proof; require Blender manual guidance.
blockedReasons.ANIMATION_OR_DIGEST_ENVELOPE_CONFLICT: Existing animation, BODY, FACE, TALKING, skin, or digest preservation cannot be proven.

diagnosticContract.directRule: All required evidence passes and the P01 conservative acceptance method selects one mapping per semantic ID.
diagnosticContract.adaptableRule: Mapping is uniquely evidenced but requires a documented semantic transform convention; no upstream rename, rest-pose edit, reparenting, or weight repair is allowed.
diagnosticContract.blockedRule: Any required evidence failure, any listed blocked reason, or absent P01 lock is fail-closed.

gltfAppendOnlyContract.source: Input GLB raw bytes are hashed before processing and never modified in place.
gltfAppendOnlyContract.restPose: Existing node TRS or matrix values are immutable. Every appended motion's neutral sample must reproduce the recorded existing local rest pose under the P01 locked comparison method.
gltfAppendOnlyContract.existingAnimations: All existing animation objects, channels, samplers, target node/path pairs, sampler input/output accessor raw bytes, and interpolation values are inventoried and preserved in the digest envelope. Existing animation objects are never edited, reordered, or removed.
gltfAppendOnlyContract.newAnimations: Each hand motion is a new, uniquely named animation object. It may target mapped existing hand/finger nodes only with rotation channels; it must use new sampler input and output accessors and the P01-locked interpolation convention. Translation, scale, morph-weight, and unrelated-node channels are prohibited.
channelRules: channel target node and path are explicit
accessor component type, type, count, min, max, buffer-view range, and raw-byte digest are receipted
gltfAppendOnlyContract.appendOnly: Append new data only after staging validation. No mutation of pre-existing nodes, skins, meshes, primitives, accessors, buffer views, materials, images, or animations is permitted.

sourceAndBody: inverse-bind-matrix accessor metadata and raw-byte digests
all mesh primitives including attributes, indices, mode, material, morph-target references, and referenced accessor raw-byte digests
existingAnimations: sampler input/output accessor metadata and raw-byte digests
faceTalking: TALKING clip identity and animation evidence
existing Post-V2 FACE/TALKING report/digest references when supplied
digestEnvelope.passMeaning: BODY_PRESERVATION_PASS and FACE_TALKING_PRESERVATION_PASS require equality for the declared pre-existing envelope. New append-only animation structures are documented separately, not silently included as preserved source structures.

qualityGates.HAND_RIG_PASS: Resolved existing hand/finger hierarchy and skin/IBM evidence; never bone creation.
qualityGates.HAND_MAPPING_PASS: One semantic mapping accepted per required ID by the P01 conservative method.
qualityGates.HAND_WEIGHT_PASS: Validation of pre-existing weights only. It never means weights were repaired, painted, synthesized, normalized, or otherwise changed.
qualityGates.HAND_MOTION_PASS: P1 motion clips open, fist, wave, point, and thumbs_up are append-only, structurally valid, and visually accepted under the P01 lock.
qualityGates.NEUTRAL_RETURN_PASS: The return sample meets the P01 rest-pose comparison method without editing the upstream rest pose.
qualityGates.BODY_PRESERVATION_PASS: Declared source/body node, skin, IBM, primitive, and existing-animation envelope is equal.
qualityGates.FACE_TALKING_PRESERVATION_PASS: Declared FACE morph and TALKING animation envelope is equal and simultaneous hand proof is accepted.
qualityGates.GLB_RELOAD_PASS: Published GLB reloads and its new channels/accessors/interpolation validate against the staged receipt.

humanVisualReceiptSchema.publicationRule: Do not commit GLBs, screenshots, raw sample identifiers, absolute paths, authority bundles, or receipts containing them.

publishAndRollback.staging: Write candidate GLB and complete receipt only to a unique private staging location.
publishAndRollback.atomicPublish: Check final target absence immediately before one atomic publish operation. Publish only the complete validated candidate and receipt set.
publishAndRollback.noClobber: An existing final target yields OUTPUT_ALREADY_EXISTS and no overwrite.
publishAndRollback.rollback: On any failure, leave no partial final output; discard or retain the private staging candidate only under private retention policy and emit a fail-closed receipt.

deferred: POST-V2-CR-HAND-02 finger-bone creation and weight synthesis
GitBlobDigestRule: The proposed SPEC digest is SHA-256 of this file's Git blob raw bytes, encoded UTF-8 with LF line endings; do not hash a pretty-printed reserialization, a platform CRLF conversion, or a Git object header.
